scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and finite independent checks supplied. The known tree-parking model, Abelian property, and Poisson approximation principles are explicitly credited; no external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete deterministic height-two b-ary trees; independent uniform preference draws; upward one-space parking. Fixed-count convergence has no claimed quantitative rate. Beyond-scope shapes and historical-priority completeness are unresolved.
title: A five-eighths parking threshold and Poisson overflow law on two-level trees
